papers.title: Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-8 with Encapsulated Naringin Synergistically Improves Antibacterial and Osteogenic Properties of Ti Implants for Osseointegration.
papers.abstract: Titanium (Ti)-based implants are widely utilized in artificial joints, pedicle screws, and dental implantations due to their excellent biocompatibility, near perfect mechanical capacities, and strong corrosion resistance. However, the Ti substrates are bioinert and lack desirable antibacterial abilities, severely hindering their bone regeneration applications. Herein, the titania nanotubes (TNTs) are fabricated onto the Ti surfaces through anodic oxidation. They are then modified with naringin (Nar)-loaded zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) in order to obtain a multifunctional coating (TNT-ZIF-8@Nar) via hydrothermal treatment. The TNT-ZIF-8@Nar exhibits excellent pH-responsive properties and a strong antimicrobial effect against Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) by releasing Zn2+ and Nar. TNT-ZIF-8@Nar coatings significantly enhance the proliferation and osteogenic differentiation of osteoblasts. Furthermore, in vivo studies demonstrated the efficacy of TNT-ZIF-8@Nar coatings in improving osseointegration and antibacterial capabilities. This work shows the promising therapeutic potential of TNT-ZIF-8@Nar in its ability to inhibit implant-associated infections and achieve favorable osseointegration simultaneously.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛植入体的表面涂层改性以促进骨整合和抗菌，与用户的3D打印生物医学植入物、AI打印或有限元代理方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve additive manufacturing (LPBF), mechanical testing (fatigue or static), porous structure design for stress shielding, or any surrogate/AI modeling; it focuses on surface coating with drug-loaded MOFs.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛植入体缺乏抗菌和骨整合能力，需要多功能涂层。
summary_zh.method: 通过阳极氧化制备二氧化钛纳米管，再负载柚皮苷的ZIF-8涂层。
summary_zh.result: 涂层具有pH响应释放，抗菌和促进成骨分化效果，体内促进骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the bioinertness and lack of antibacterial properties of titanium implants for improved osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Titania nanotubes were fabricated by anodic oxidation and then modified with naringin-loaded ZIF-8 via hydrothermal treatment.
summary_en.result: The multifunctional coating exhibited pH-responsive release, strong antibacterial effect, and enhanced osteoblast proliferation and differentiation; in vivo studies confirmed improved osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo animal studies.

papers.title: Filamented Light (FLight) Biofabrication of Highly Aligned Tissue‐Engineered Constructs
papers.abstract: Cell-laden hydrogels used in tissue engineering generally lack sufficient 3D topographical guidance for cells to mature into aligned tissues. A new strategy called filamented light (FLight) biofabrication rapidly creates hydrogels composed of unidirectional microfilament networks, with diameters on the length scale of single cells. Due to optical modulation instability, a light beam is divided optically into FLight beams. Local polymerization of a photoactive resin is triggered, leading to local increase in refractive index, which itself creates self-focusing waveguides and further polymerization of photoresin into long hydrogel microfilaments. Diameter and spacing of the microfilaments can be tuned from 2 to 30 µm by changing the coherence length of the light beam. Microfilaments show outstanding cell instructive properties with fibroblasts, tenocytes, endothelial cells, and myoblasts, influencing cell alignment, nuclear deformation, and extracellular matrix deposition. FLight is compatible with multiple types of photoresins and allows for biofabrication of centimeter-scale hydrogel constructs with excellent cell viability within seconds (<10 s per construct). Multidirectional microfilaments are achievable within a single hydrogel construct by changing the direction of FLight projection, and complex multimaterial/multicellular tissue-engineered constructs are possible by sequentially exchanging the cell-laden photoresin. FLight offers a transformational approach to developing anisotropic tissues using photo-crosslinkable biomaterials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及人工智能，与AI生物打印方向无直接关联，但可作为生物制造背景了解。
llm.why_not_core: This paper describes a purely optics-based biofabrication method with no AI/ML integration, no data-driven modeling, and no autonomous decision-making in the bioprinting workflow.

summary_zh.motivation: 组织工程水凝胶缺乏3D拓扑引导细胞定向成熟
summary_zh.method: 利用光调制不稳定性将光束分裂为FLight束，自聚焦聚合形成定向微丝
summary_zh.result: 快速生成厘米级定向水凝胶结构，有效调控细胞排列和基质沉积
summary_zh.validation: 通过四种细胞(成纤维/腱/内皮/成肌)实验验证微丝诱导细胞定向能力

summary_en.motivation: Conventional cell-laden hydrogels lack sufficient 3D topographical cues for aligned tissue maturation.
summary_en.method: Filamented light biofabrication exploits optical modulation instability to split a light beam into self-focusing waveguides, inducing localized polymerization and forming unidirectional hydrogel microfilaments.
summary_en.result: Centimeter-scale hydrogel constructs with tunable microfilament diameters (2–30 µm) are fabricated within seconds, demonstrating excellent cell alignment, nuclear deformation, and ECM deposition.
summary_en.validation: In vitro experiments with fibroblasts, tenocytes, endothelial cells, and myoblasts validated the cell-instructive properties of the microfilaments.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM钛合金的表面后处理，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合，与用户研究方向间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface roughness improvement via abrasive jet machining, but does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究微磨料气射流加工对SLM Ti-6Al-4V表面质量的影响机理。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验分析不同加工参数下的表面粗糙度变化。
summary_zh.result: 确定了优化参数组合以显著改善表面质量。
summary_zh.validation: 采用表面粗糙度测量仪进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence mechanism of micro-abrasive air jet machining on the surface quality of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Experimental parametric study measuring surface roughness under varying jet pressure, abrasive size, and processing time.
summary_en.result: Optimal processing parameters were identified that significantly improve surface finish by reducing average roughness.
summary_en.validation: Surface roughness measurements using profilometry confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed machining parameters.
